batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c Younis Khan b SR Watson

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c D Salunkhe b YK Pathan

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b PP Chawla

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b JR Hopes

batting.name: Kamran Akmal
batting.dismissal: c WA Mota b PP Chawla

balls.text: cracked hard to mid-off, they need to run for everything and he's short of his crease, Watson collects the throw from Yusuf and whips the bails off
That's huge! Five sixes in his last six balls from Yuvraj, too short and he's decimated that over midwicket for a biggie, flat and hard, howitzered that
short and that's blasted, cracked flat to deep square leg
short and angling into the body, pulled to fine leg for a single

surprise, surprise, no six. He's holed out to midwicket and the curtains comes down on a fizzer of an innings. Tries to pick it up from outside off to midwicket but doesn't manage the elevation. Long-on runs in towards deep midwicket to take a catch
he backs away but that's too far outside off, wide called and rightly so
short and he's top edged that, when you're on top there's little that can stop you, Marsh tries to pull but it flies away through fine leg for four

he's pounding them as if at a net, this is becoming into a joke now, full and on the pads, picks it up and punctures that, another flat six and it strikes the rope on the full, Stuart Broad must be loving this
cramping him for room, worked away to square leg
yorker-length again, played back to the bowler
full and wide, yorker-length again, he tries to square drive but can't make contact, appeal goes up but that was far away from the bat

It's raining but play is going to continue. That's because it's raining sixes, latches on to a good-length ball and smokes that over long-on, another clearing of the front foot and pulverised over long-on for six, spectators need helmets
yorker and this is the time to bowl it, Marsh backs away but is beaten there, fine ball
and another, this is almost as big as the first one, he's striking sixes as if popping peanuts, stand and blast, all the way over midwicket, big, bigger, biggest
that's savaged, slightly short and he's tonked that, hard, flat, speedy, furious, whoa! That was some bat speed, ripper
that's following Phoenix to Mars, good-length ball, in the slot, he's stood still and swung with an almighty fury, way, way over midwicket for four, any life on Mars?
full one, driven to long-off, dug that out there
107kph this time, slow, slower, slowest, his variation is based on slowness, another attempted pull and he's beaten again
115kph, when in doubt, Trivedi bowls the slower one, Marsh pulls but he's too early on it, fine ball
full and straight, picks it up and hammers it through square leg, Yusuf puts int he diving  save but can't get there
short and outside off, pulled away towards deep midwicket and they get three, I think the boundaries haven't been brought in today. Hasn't mattered to Marsh, though
slower one this time, slightly short, he's tried the pull but the thick top edge goes over the bowler's head for a single
and now Yuvraj, too short and he's swivelled around to pull that behind square, nobody is missing out here

Ladies and gentlemen, here comes the future, pushed that down the ground and brings up a sizzling hundred, the helmet is off and he's beaming, why wouldn't he? This has been one of the best knocks of the tournament.
wide this time, Marsh has messed with everyone's plans here, Pankaj tries another slower one but it's too far outside off
slow one but he's got a high full toss, he's lost control of that, Marsh waits and lofts over extra cover, not much timing but that's a no-ball, takes him to 99
this is brutal, clears his front foot and judders that straight back over the bowlers head, nobody is going to get that, straight and over, six all the way
short of a length ball, thinks of the slog sweep but can't make proper contact, deflects to square leg
tries to wait and blast over long-on but another that strikes the bottom part of the bat, rushes towards long-on
too far down the leg side, and it's quick too, Yuvraj simply helps that along past short fine leg for four
93kph, a slider this time, outside off and its too quick for Yuvraj, tries to cut but misses, he's let out a grimace
tries to slog sweep but it gets the toe end of the bat and rushes past the bowler to long-off
full and slightly wide, judders that to short extra cover
angled his bat to get a single to third man, he's retained the strike
pushed to mid-on, slightly slower ball this time

please fasten your seat-belts, we're being propelled into orbit by Shaun Marsh, this is base-ball fireworks now, gets his front foot out of the way and lambasts that over extra cover for a flat six, expect a statue of Swampy junior outside the stadium soon
short one, bit of extra bounce there, Yuvraj pulls but isn't in control, it was in the air for a while but drops short of Salunkhe at square leg, that was streaky
short one this time, went through quickly too, Yuvraj thinks of slashing but drops his hands in the last moment
too wide but another slower one, slashed but straight to deep backward point
steps back and pushes confidently through midwicket, more good timing but only one here
on the front foot and glided to third man for a single
goes for the sweep but can't get hold of it, soars straight to deep midwicket and Salunkhe needed to take only a couple of steps to take that one, end of a cracking knock
pushed to midwicket

and this is even better, waltzes down the track and plasters that over long-on for another biggie, these are striking nothing but the meat of the bat, what neat parabolas the ball is travelling in, all the way into the crowd
down the track and bang, flat-bats that towards long-on for four, "not a man move" as they say in the West Indies
short one, he goes for the pull but is done in by the extra bounce, Rawat, who is keeping by the way, appeals but there was no edge there
136.8kph, fullish ball, driven back but Munaf stops that with a jump
full and wide, bit too wide in fact, he throws his bat at it but can't beat deep point, they settle for one
the ground has just been set on fire with a blistering cover drive, it's a low full toss and he's stood still to blast that through the covers, the grass burnt there for sure, what a ripper
good yorker, he was waiting to swing the arms but digs it out to long-on for a single
132.2kph, full and outside off, steered to third man, it seems Marsh is consolidating now for Hopes to blast
bit of extra bounce for Yusuf, Hopes tries to move back and turn it but padded away close to the off side
102.2kph, flat and on middle, punched towards deep extra cover for a couple, that brings up his fifty, cracking innings this
little shimmy down the track and punched to long-off
driven to long-on, these two have rotated the strike womderfully
that's huge, slower this time and outside off but the slog-sweep comes out and he's connected superbly, deposited in the crowds
darted into the pads, worked away in front of square
good-length ball that's slightly wide, flayed hard but only manages a top-edge that soars over the in-field, no fielder patrolling that area and they manage two
another slower one, checked his off-drive and scampers through
pushed to long-on for a single, they're doing it easy now
another slower one, too predictable here it seems, Hopes waits on it and pulls behind square for four more, these two are simply putting the steam-roller on now
streaky but he's got away with that, walks down the track but is faced with a yorker-length ball, thick outside edge runs away past short third man, four more, nothing, it seems, can go wrong today
that's as neat as they come, right-handed Marsh almost, for that shot at least, on the pads and flicked cleanly over midwicket, one-bounce for four there
tries another slog sweep but can't get the timing right, strikes the bottom of the bat and dribbles to short midwicket
glided away towards third man
too wide this time, it's full and he's slog-swept that over long-on, clean striking this, hand-eye co-ordination from heaven, no chance for any fielder there
quicker one on the pads, pushed towards midwicket
that's a gimme, too short but Hopes hasn't timed that too well, strikes the bottom part of the bat and floats towards midwicket, drops short of the fielder, but Hopes missed out there
slightly short, bit of turn but he's quick enough to rock back and pull towards midwicket, comfortable two
slower again, slashed away but it's too close to the point fielder to take a single
good length delivery on the leg stump, Marsh flicks it off his hips to deep midwicket for a couple
fuller delivery on the off stump, Marsh guides it to point
slower delivery on the middle stump and shaping away, Marsh looks to run  it down to third man but fails to get any willow on it
slower one, outside off, pushed confidently to mid-on, waits for that
full and outside off, glided to third man, everything he does is so calm, no real hurry in those shots
quicker one, angling in, tapped to mid-on
fuller and he pushes towards mid-on
too short and Marsh is not going to let those freebies go, rocks back and pulls through midwicket for four, that's one-bounce to the fence and he's got the orange cap. What a talent!
bit too short, he waits on it and cracks to point
pushed off the back foot to cover, bit of turn
too wide outside off, cut away past point
straighter and doesn't give him much room, sets himself up for the cut but adjusts to tap down the ground
128.9kph, pushed to cover, waits on that one
short and that's pulled through midwicket, he's getting into the party now, over the infield for four more
slightly slower, bit wide and he's caressed that past point
too full and he's laced that through extra cover for another four, hitting through the line and making the most of this belter of a pitch
he's going for the aerial bombardment now, picks the short one and pulls it over midwicket for a biggie, he's stood still and clobbered that hard
tapped towards cover
short of a length this time, deep point in place now, keeps them to one
too wide and Marsh is not going to miss out, he's given the kitchen sink at that one, flayed over cover for four, he's running away with this now, what a ripper
as hard as it gets now, full and wide, what a fiery shot that, on the up and blasted towards Hopes, he evades the screamer and that runs away, nobody is going to stop that
straight this time, pushed to point, not much room to play with there
yorker length, 137kph, pushed the low full toss to midwicket and they hurry through
slow one again, pushed to midwicket for a quick one
pushed to mid-on, they think of a run but that would have been too reckless
one-handed flay there, backs away and crashes that over point for four, the top-hand came off but that was racing away
punched to cover off the back foot
not much bounce again, came on too slowly, he thought it was short enough for a pull but is foxed by that one
short of a length, he tries to rock back and drive but can't beat the field
drives hard but good diving stop by the cover fielder
on the pads and he goes for the flick, they manage a leg bye
checked his shot there, full and punched to cover
short and cut away savagely, sensational hitting this, clean and no slogging at all, Western Australia taking the attack to Queensland here, could have easily been the Ford Mutual Cup.

that's a stunner, short and angling away from the left-hander, he stands tall and pulls with Caribbean flourish, that was struck so hard that it nearly carried all the way over midwicket for six, what a shot
pushed to cover and they take off, think of two but decide against it
gives himself a bit of room, tapes towards gully
pushed confidently back to the bowler, good stop from Munaf
that's whistled over the bowler's head, full and he's taken a small stride forward and smacked it straight over for four, what a follow-through, that's soared towards the sight-screens
fluently timed but straight to the fielder, full ball that's punched to mid-off
down the leg side, no need to touch that one
pushed to the covers, back of a length this time and not so short
short and pulled away hard, through midwicket, he was quick to get onto that
too wide and he's latched on, spanked through point for another four, that's a screamer too, this is Marsh-land
some good inswing again, shapes into the batsman, he can't get the timing right, appeal for lbw but that pitched outside leg
slightly fuller, looks for the cut but that's too close to his body, tapped to the off side
that's a scorcher, full and outside off, rips that out of the screws and gets the gap, not much feet movement but when you can time it so well ...
slightly wide of off, some swing again but not as much, pushed to mid-off
swings in well into the let-hander, Marsh set up for the big drive but that comes back and cramps him for room, thick inside edge back to the bowler
that's left him a shade, pushing tentatively, beats the outside edge
that's sliding on the pads and he's flicked effortlessly, fast outfield and that's raced away behind square for four
and this keeps a bit low, waits for it and pats it back towards mid-on
slightly wide this time, he tries to cut but it bounces a bit higher
short of a length, not that much bounce this time, tapped to the off side and they take off
one slip in place, angling away from the left-hander, some bounce early on, lets it go
tight till the finish, full and outside off, Pankaj charges down the track but can't make contact. Just two off the last over, now that's bizarre.
slower one this time, 111.9kph, another swing and another miss, it misses off stump too
fine yorker, pushed back to the bowler
keeps low this time, just misses the off stump and Pankaj's wild swing meets air
slower one this time, tries to blast it over midwicket but the leading edge pops towards mid-on, they scamper through
44 off the last over, yorker outside off, dug out towards short midwicket for one
and another, short ball but that was rising on him, too quick for Salunkhe and he can only get a skier as he tries to pull, high in the air but Hopes ensures he has it covered.
slower one this time, pummeled towards square leg, Marsh dives and keeps them to two
walks across and paddles that over short fine leg, he loves this shot, falls in the follow through but the result makes him smile
tries a paddle sweep past short fine leg but can't make contact

yorker again, makes a clumsy attempt to dig it out and tries a single, he's a few feet down when Hopes runs up and tries to run him out, the batsman strangely offers Hopes a full view of the stumps but he misses
End of hopes, he's swung that to square leg and Marsh has pulled off a fine catch, diving forward and latching on clean, not that well timed from Yusuf this time. Hopes seals it
whoa! full and outside off, backs off and pelts that through extra-cover for four, that was like an oxygen pipe in a gas chamber, keeps Rajasthan barely alive. Now it's Yusuf time
dot again, full and driven straight back to the bowler
lofted over midwicket but can't get the timing right, they get a couple and you can either see it as a good result or a bad one
that's more like it, straight and full, lofted over the bowler and it runs away for four, dive from long-on but he can't make it
full and wide, he's missed again, oh dear, Yusuf at the other end and you get beaten outside off, having said that good pace from VRV
full yorker from VRV, he tries to back away and cut but no bat on that
full and on pads, squirted away to fine leg for a single
that's a good yorker, on leg stump, 130kph, pushed towards short midwicket, and it's a single, asking rate shoots up
full again, and he's thundered that through midwicket, Powar dives but he can't beat the pace of this one, he's striking them from the sweet spot, another four, peanuts boss peanuts

peanuts, says Yusuf, he's whistled that through covers for four more, stands back and thumps that with immense power, burns the carpet, Hopes has begun to talk to himself. Yusuf has strange effects on people
too wide and it's cracked hard, he's smoked that, the fielder comes across but his feet are on the rope when he gets the ball, fine stop first up but he messed up then, good effort but that's four

tries to moves across and paddle it over short fine leg, struck on the pads and they take off, Hopes tries to dive and get the direct hit, Yusuf dives to get in, the two are in a photo finish but the ball misses the stumps. Beijing anybody?
and another yorker, no room to play with, juddered to midwicket
cracked hard but it's straight to extra cover, he's backing away too now, but VRV is sticking to yorker length
another yorker, backs away but can only shovel it towards extra-cover
yorker this time, backs away and drives hard to square leg, they get two but even that is OK at this time of the innings
short of a length, outside off, tries to cut but is beaten
tries to loft a full one over midwicket but can't get the timing, straight to short midwicket for a quick one, Powar misses the stumps and all safe
down the track again, googly this time, strikes him on the pad and trickles to the on side
oh ho! Rawat has arrived, it's tossed up but it's tossed back, waltz down the track and blasted over his head for a biggie, what a shot, peanut popping time
he thinks of coming down the track, thick inside edge deflects to the on side
slightly short but it's quick, tapped to extra cover for a quick one
pushed to the on side for a quick one
got 'em! Akmal has holed out, down the track and he couldn't get the timing, lofted towards extra cover and Mota is waiting there, straight into his palms and one rapid innings ends
yorker-length this time, outside off, pushed firmly to long-on but can't get the elevation, they settle for one
massacre this, full and on middle and leg, he's cleared his front foot and swung it way, way over midwicket for one more, this is book cricket now, Akmal is soaring here, now then, is there a twist?
that's aimed at Lahore, slower one again and he's waited for that, brutal slog sweep over midwicket, that's a smashing shot, the Royals are jumping in the dug-out now
that's massive! good-length ball on the pads, Akmal walks across and swings clean over backward square leg for six, that's a biggie, he can strike them clean this boy

full and outside off, punched hard to midwicket and Yusuf takes off, he needs to make a lot of ground to get back, Powar lets out a throw to the bowler but it's too wide and by the time Sreesanth whips off the bails, Brother Yo is home. All safe
slower one, outside off and he's punched off the back foot, mis-field by Marsh at short extra cover and it trickles away for four, quick outfield this
another clean swing but this time they need to settle for a couple, driven crunchily to midwicket but Hopes mops up
Take that Piyush, it's full, it's flighted, Yusuf eases into it and blasts that way over long-on for six, these are clean golf swings into the crowd
pre-mediated sweep from outside off, they go up in appeal but that struck the bat, they hurry a single to short fine leg
Yusuf sweeps powerfully but straight to backward square leg
he's holed out! full and punched straight into the throat of long-on, neatly struck but he's found the fielder, no distance there, Chawla gets his man. Irfan gets an easy catch.
holds that back, 77kph, swept away to square leg
hammered back down the ground, the bowler gets a hand to it but it's timed well enough for them to get two, no direct hit and it's all safe
quick and flat, tries to cut but the inside edge deflects onto the pads, they hurry through for one
now then, this is the power of Brother Yo, not that well timed but that's soared over long-off for another six, easily done, two in two
what a start for Yusuf! He's got his front foot forward and smacked it way over long-on for six, now that's what I call getting your eye in
bit short again but it's quick, tries to loft again but the top edge nearly pops to long-off, dropped short, though
slightly short, it kept a bit low but he waited for that one and lofted it towards midwicket for four, he played that with a straight bat

castled! a quicker one, that's a toppie that hurries on to the batsman, he tries to pull but it crashes into the off stump, Niraj's cameo comes to and end, Piyush gives him a send off. Hope his mum isn't watching.
googly that Watson late-cuts but Sreesanth pulls off another fine save at short third man
it was high time now, bit of a long-hop and outside leg, he's plonked his foot forward and swivelled around to pull that hard over backward square leg for six, biggie
reverse-paddle attempted but he can't beat short third man (or fine leg, if you will)
little shimmy down the ground and cracked straight down the ground, good stop at long-off, keeps them to two
83kph, fuller one, pushed hard to midwicket
yorker that time, dug out to midwicket and they they hurry through, mis-field allows them to get there safe
full and powerfully driven but can't get the timing, doesn't cross mid-off
short again, pulls again, four again, he's good with the pull but they seem to be targeting him there, nice way to bring up the fifty, he's continued from where he left off that night
extra bounce, slashes towards third man but what a stop from Wilkin Mota at third man, full-length dive and saves a certain four, fine athleticism from Mota (which in Hindi means fat)
short this time, rocks back and pulls behind square, finds the gap there, that was uppish but safe in the gap
good-length ball outside off, tries to loft straight but the thickish edge deflects to square leg
googly this time, 89kph, he goes for the cut but it spins away
a bit short again, pulled away but straight to deep midwicket, one-bounce to him
slightly short, he pulls but not much timing, straight to midwicket
angling away from the left-hander, he tries to glide it to the third man region but is beaten, Sangakkara fumbled that but no edge
full and outside off, worked away to the leg side
all ready to go after that but can only work it away behind square leg for a single. Someone has to go now. Niraj maybe better off against the legbreak bowler
punched to gully, good length from VRV
wide of the stumps, wild slash from Watson and the leading edge flies towards third man, bounces a few feet in front of the man there, desperate times call for desperate measures
high full toss there, Watson surprised by that, can't get the timing at all as it's played back to the bowler, touch-and-go with regard to the full toss above the waist, not called
slightly short again, pulls that but not much timing, straight to fine leg
swivels around to pull that but the deep square leg is in place, cracking shot but straight to the fielder, bit too short from VRV
132.3kph, straight and good-length, confident push back to the bowler
sweeps hard from outside off, they need to settle for one as backward square leg tidies up
flighting that from round the wicket, swept to square leg for a single
he's waited and pulled hard, rocks back and powers that through midwicket for four, bit of a long-hop from Powar, needs to be fuller
charges down, done in by the spin, padded away towards the leg side for a quick one
85kph, worked away towards short midwicket
tossed up straight away, holds up a bit after pitches, turns too, cut away without much timing, they hurry through
slashes hard at a slower one, point is deep so keeps them down to a single, he's hitting them confidently, though
cramps him for room on the leg side, pushed to the on side, these dots may hurt them, Punjab managed singles and twos throughout
that's hammered through covers, he's backed away and cracked that hard through extra cover, finds the gap again, four more

oh that was a chance, pushed to cover, they think of a single but Watson needs to go back, Marsh picks up and takes a shy at the stumps but misses, Watson would have been well short there, close shave
the crowd are buzzing here but Niraj is calmly collecting fours, full and a bit of width, glided through backward point for four, that's some lovely timing
130kph, short of a length, patted to cover but can't beat the field
fends tentatively outside off, that's short of a length but angling away from the batsman, could have easily feathered that to the keeper

cleaned him up, Younis attempts to slog across the line but the ball swings in a shade and rattles leg stump, he's been trying this shot for a while but Irfan is on target this time, Rajasthan lose wicket No.2
141.8kph, punched to cover and they take off, fine over so far
full and more swing, speedy too, Niraj drives but is beaten again, Pathan is proving to be a tough nut to crack
patted back to the bowler
fine swing there, starting from outside off and moving away, NIraj dabs but is beaten, fine bit of shape for Pathan
low full toss, glided towards gully and they hurry through
glorious, there's some width there and he's lacing these effortlessly, stands straight and caresses it past point for another four, stringing them together now
135.5kph, short of a length, not much width this time and a bit of more bounce, he cracks it off the back foot but can't beat the cover fielder
slower one and he's waited for that, saw it coming and moved forward to spank it past the bowler, close to the non-striker's stump and that's scorched towards the sight-screen
too wide outside off, he doesn't need to worry about that
and again, this is sweet timing from Niraj, short of a length, bit of width again, he rocks back and bisects point and gully, fine timing again, he has a good game square of the wicket
cracked past point, on the back foot and he's got the timing and placement, bit of width from Sreesanth and he's latched on
full and shaping away again, pushed hard towards cover but can't get the gap
swinging away from the left-hander, square-drives but that beats the outside edge
worked away to the leg side, can't get the timing going here, hurry through for a single
tries to pick it up from outside off towards midwicket but that kept a bit low and he can't gauge the bounce, he's walking towards the ball here
137kph, good-length ball, slashes but is beaten there
short that time, getting bit on him, tapped to gully and they think of a single, sent back in time, Marsh throws but no direct hit
worked away off his hips to backward square leg
short and wide, slashed away towards third man for a single
shuffling across and pushing to long-off for a single, he has a big smile on his face after getting off the mark. It's his first game, mind you.

bowled him! Kaif charges down the track and swings across the line, he had to go for it, the asking-rate was climbing, the length and line is accurate from Sreesanth and he uproots off stump after Kaif misses
Kaif moves back to a good length ball and punches towards point
good length delivery outside off stump, Kaif mis-times the cut towards cover
Patel gets beaten once again, Pathan concedes only five off the over and the asking-rate is nearly 11 and a half
too short from Irfan, Patel moves back and lofts it with a flat bat over the bowler's head, not the most elegant but he's opened the boudnary account
once again Niraj fends off the back foot and misses
Pathan angles the ball into the left-hander and then seams it away from Niraj Patel off a good length, he pokes at it off the back foot and gets beaten
Kaif cuts a short of a length ball towards point for a single
Kaif gets an inside edge on to the pad to a ball that swings into him
